purpose: Qualify exact new SDK/native artifacts after monorepo URL metadata correction and paired version bump; no runtime algorithm changes.
sampling: Fixed 30 state CPU repeats / 31 command CPU repeats, 100 fresh fixed-age Redis windows of 100 updates and 30000 individual Cmds observations. No dropped tails, same GC and ABBA. Same shipping artifacts.
repeat_policy: One predeclared runner-isolation experiment. Retain both prior failures and all raw observations. No unchanged reruns to select a pass.
artifact_policy: Download the complete successful seven-platform wheel/source CI set, bind SDK/native/source digests and commit the input manifest before timing. Never qualify host-built substitutes.
publication_order: Cmds SDK/native; Nav SDK/native; Idle SDK/native. SDK before its native companion; Nav before Idle.
prior_evidence: Two experiments retained in initial and repeatability reports. Extended Rust-a confirmation_hit/100 has localized p95 spikes at observations 21000..27000, involuntary context switches 1425 versus 662/661 for rust-b/python-b, and CPU pressure delta about 8.2s versus 1.2s. Median Rust latency is faster. Test owned-runner scheduling contention; do not remove these observations.
runner_policy: Owned disposable GitHub-hosted VM only. Pin other owned user threads away from the client physical core and its sibling. Controller/benchmark nice -20, fixed CPU 0 selected once by topology, no real-time scheduling. All 30000 latency observations and unchanged GC, ABI, workloads and gates retained. No claim of exclusive hypervisor hardware.
